svg.title: Runtime workload protocol
svg.desc: The multistep observation journey is frozen in OBSERVATION.json (SHA256 d6c22cd7c57f16e6b9fd3da582597e494c21ba6fda39248388e022a066e4297f). Its initial state, 12 action/read states and three navigation resets produce 16 observation states. Nine action states mutate input/output; three read bundles validate static HTML, JSON and JS DOM semantics. At every state the actual current Python SDK, CLI --json, and MCP tool transport independently produce forced-full and delta responses. Every delta reconstructs exact full snapshot text, ordered refs/count and document metadata; navigation must fall back to full. Every raw observation and generated step result is retained. Initial and reset full responses remain in the aggregate denominator. Each transport has separate actual tiktoken0.12.0/o200k_base canonical-result JSON byte/token totals and a50%gate. The SDK raw result retains its human text; actual CLI JSON omits text and retains snapshot; actual MCP content plus structured result is counted as delivered. These are observation-response counts under a fixed encoding, not end-to-end agent or GPT-6 billing-tokenizer claims. The original changed-point metric remains separate and cannot establish the multistep gate. Candidate campaigns require the actual --sdk source (default sdk/python/umbra.py), record its hash and verify it remained unchanged.
